stage: Ten training cubes only; await user go before remaining collection and Plain/Oracle training.
combined_friction: (cube material friction + floor material friction)/2: verified PhysX default eAVERAGE; per-cube values only cubes.json
randomization: Separate independent RNG streams for property sampling and every (cube,episode) plan. No rejection based on physics labels.
fixed_lengths: Raw diagnostic horizon:16 push+200 coast model intervals. Saved episodes retain all16 push and coast through ceil(stop onset/model dt)+5 additional steps. Trim length, masks, stop-time and IDs are excluded from model features.
scene: Six-DOF 4 cm cube; infinite plane; 5 g spherical pusher free in XYZ, rotations locked, gravity and damping off. No Panda controller.
force: Full 3D contact force = commanded force minus known pusher mass times measured delta-velocity/.001s. No pusher translational constraints/gravity/damping/other contacts. Reject norm above cap*(1+1e-5). Normal-only PhysX API retained as diagnostic.
state: Cube position3, rotation6 (first two matrix columns), linear velocity3, angular velocity3, pusher position3, pusher velocity3. All physical observations.
action: Commanded XYZ force, cap, engaged flag, preplanned XYZ release target. No measured force or motion-dependent target.
stop: First 100ms continuously below full linear speed .001m/s and angular speed .05rad/s; confirmation excluded. Rest metadata for evaluation only.

planned_models.target: (next_state-state)/training-state std; floor .001 native units; same train-only normalization for both families
planned_models.normalization: fit exclusively on training-cube training episodes; no test normalization

planned_evaluation.aggregation: Equal weight cubes; within cube equal episodes; within episode equal eligible starts.
planned_evaluation.one_step: MSE of normalized predicted change over state columns. Also report cube-only state columns and physical position errors.
planned_evaluation.ten_step: Recursive10-step predictions, no observed intermediate states. Group by starting transition:push,moving_coast,all_steps; push/moving-coast windows stay in their phase. Commands after a trimmed file ends are extended from the fixed preplanned coast command, never stop metadata.
planned_evaluation.stopping_position: Euclidean predicted terminal XY error against recorded confirmed-rest XY. Rollouts from eligible starts in each score group use the fixed physical horizon1s after release, not observed trimmed length or true stop time; zero-force coast commands are extended from the plan.
planned_evaluation.coast_masks: Moving coast:phase coast AND observed current full linear speed>.001m/s OR angular speed>.05rad/s, with the phase test applying to both. All steps:all retained push+coast. Report each group separately.
planned_evaluation.primary_gate: Moving-coast one-step NMSE:mean Oracle <= .8*mean Plain AND Oracle mean+sampleSD < Plain mean-sampleSD across five paired seeds. Push,moving-coast,all-step scores required for every comparison; no all-coast substitution.
planned_evaluation.seed_spread: Sample SD over five seeds; also paired seedwise improvements. No test-driven tuning.

action_probe: Rerun on actual ten-cube pilot:pooled leave-one-cube-out R2 using fixed16-step push-command prefixes. Separately diagnose outcome-dependent trimmed length with length-only and commands+length probes. Supplement with planned200/30 generator audit; no extra motion.
